config.name: Environment Health Executive — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Environment Health Executive Overview
Leadership-density view of where risk is concentrated — without deep operational tables.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • Where is risk concentrated geographically or by type?
  • Are dead or minimally monitored resources rising?
  • Are collectors and websites signaling trouble?
Recommended review flow
  1. Map + NOC — Concentration
  2. Dead / minimal / websites — Blind spots
  3. Collector pulse — Trust in data
  4. Drill to Ops — Resource Health / Alerts
Where to go next
  • Operational Resource Health → 22
  • Active Alerts → 21
  • Collector Diagnostics → 31
  • Websites → 23 / 13
Tip: Empty or zero values may mean healthy state or missing tokens/LogicModules — confirm before concluding.
